settings.heading: What is Mounjaro (tirzepatide)?
settings.what: Mounjaro is a prescription-only injectable medicine containing tirzepatide, approved in the UK for weight management in adults. It mimics two gut hormones, GIP and GLP-1, which help regulate appetite and blood sugar, so you feel fuller and eat less.
settings.who: Usually prescribed to adults with a BMI of 30 or above, or 27 or above with at least one weight-related condition such as high blood pressure or type 2 diabetes. A clinical assessment and valid prescription are required; it can't be bought over the counter.
settings.dosing: Treatment starts at 2.5mg once a week and can be increased in steps up to 15mg, depending on how well you tolerate it and how you respond. Prices vary a lot by dose, so check the table for your current dose.

settings.question: Do I need a prescription for Mounjaro in the UK?
settings.answer: Yes. Mounjaro (tirzepatide) is a prescription-only medicine. Every pharmacy in our table includes an online consultation with a UK prescriber.

settings.question: Is Mounjaro available on the NHS in 2026?
settings.answer: Yes, but mainly through limited specialist NHS weight management services for patients who meet strict criteria. Many people pay privately, which is why we compare private prices.

settings.question: How do I get a Mounjaro prescription online?
settings.answer: Through a GPhC-registered online pharmacy with a digital consultation. It typically takes 24 to 48 hours, and you don't need a GP referral.

settings.question: Which Mounjaro dose is right for me?
settings.answer: Mounjaro comes in six doses: 2.5mg, 5mg, 7.5mg, 10mg, 12.5mg and 15mg. You usually start at 2.5mg and step up every 4 weeks under your prescriber's guidance. See our Mounjaro price by dose guide for what each dose costs and when you reach it.

settings.answer: Yes. {codes:mounjaro} pharmacies currently list an offer for Mounjaro. See them all, with each code ready to copy, on our Mounjaro discount codes page, or use the Discount column in the table above.

settings.question: How much weight can I expect to lose on Mounjaro?
settings.answer: In clinical trials, people on the 15mg dose lost up to 22.5% of their body weight on average over 72 weeks. Results vary with diet, activity and sticking to the treatment plan.

settings.heading: Why Mounjaro prices differ between pharmacies
settings.lead: The medicine is the same Lilly pen wherever you buy it, so the difference comes from the pharmacy's pricing:
settings.text:
• Introductory prices. Some pharmacies discount the first month only. Check what you will pay from month two.
  • Discount codes. {codes:mounjaro} of the {n:mounjaro} pharmacies currently offer a code, and many work on your first order only. See today's Mounjaro discount codes.
  • What's included. Most prices include the online consultation, prescription and standard delivery. A few charge for these separately, or for needles and a sharps bin.
  • Bundles. Some pharmacies charge less per month when you buy two or three months at once.
  • Lilly's list price. In September 2025 Lilly raised the UK list price of Mounjaro, with the highest dose going from £122 to £330 a month. Today the cheapest 15mg price is {min:mounjaro:15mg}.

settings.heading: How to pay less for Mounjaro, safely
settings.text:
1. Compare the dose you will be on next month, not only the starting dose. Prices rise with each step.
  2. Check the price after month one, not only the introductory offer.
  3. Use the discount code shown next to the pharmacy.
  4. Only buy from a pharmacy on the GPhC register. Every pharmacy on MedEazy has been checked.
  5. You can change pharmacy to get a better price. The new pharmacy will carry out its own consultation and may ask for proof of your current prescription. See Can I change pharmacy?
  6. Never buy Mounjaro from social media sellers or websites that don't ask for a consultation.
